title: One day in Busan: an easy east-coast route

slides.title: Only one day?
slides.voice: Only one day in Busan? Stick to the east coast. This route keeps the stops close, so you spend minutes—not hours—getting around.

slides.title: Temple by the sea
slides.sub: Go early to beat the crowds
slides.voice: Start early at Haedong Yonggungsa, a rare Korean temple right above the sea. Allow about an hour, and keep your voice low.

slides.title: Haeundae Beach
slides.sub: Save beach time for late morning
slides.voice: Then head back to Haeundae Beach. Walk the sand and promenade, and remember that summer weekends get busy.

slides.title: Market snacks
slides.voice: For lunch, try Haeundae Traditional Market, just a short walk from the beach. Look for fish cakes or tteokbokki.

slides.title: Dinner by the sea
slides.voice: Return to Haeundae for dinner, then walk the beach at night. Or take a short taxi to Gwangalli Beach to see Gwangan Bridge lit after dark.

slides.title: Full guide and tips
slides.voice: The full guide is on Korea Plainly. Link in bio.
